description: This file contains functions and classes for managing document stores, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, chunk management, and processing loaders within a server-side application. It interacts with a database via TypeORM, handles file storage, and integrates with various components for document processing.

classes.name: IDocumentStoreFileChunkPagedResponse
classes.description: Interface representing a paginated response of document store file chunks.

classes.name: IDocumentStoreLoader
classes.description: Interface representing a loader within a document store, including its configuration and status.

classes.name: IDocumentStoreLoaderFile
classes.description: Interface representing a file associated with a document store loader.

classes.name: IDocumentStoreLoaderForPreview
classes.description: Interface for previewing document store loaders, including configuration and rehydration status.

classes.name: IDocumentStoreUpsertData
classes.description: Interface for data used to upsert (update or insert) a document store.

classes.name: IDocumentStoreWhereUsed
classes.description: Interface representing chat flows that use a particular document store.

classes.name: IExecutePreviewLoader
classes.description: Interface for executing preview loader operations.

classes.name: IExecuteProcessLoader
classes.description: Interface for executing process loader operations.

classes.name: IExecuteVectorStoreInsert
classes.description: Interface for inserting data into a vector store.

classes.name: INodeData
classes.description: Interface representing node data used in component nodes.

methods.name: createDocumentStore
methods.description: Creates a new document store in the database and sends telemetry.

methods.name: getAllDocumentStores
methods.description: Retrieves all document stores for a given workspace, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getAllDocumentFileChunksByDocumentStoreIds
methods.description: Fetches file chunks for multiple document store IDs.

methods.name: deleteLoaderFromDocumentStore
methods.description: Removes a specific loader and its associated files and chunks from a document store.

methods.name: getDocumentStoreById
methods.description: Retrieves a document store by its ID within a workspace.

methods.name: getUsedChatflowNames
methods.description: Gets chat flow names that are using a specific document store.

methods.name: getDocumentStoreFileChunks
methods.description: Retrieves file chunks for a specific loader or store, with pagination.

methods.name: deleteDocumentStore
methods.description: Deletes a document store and all associated chunks, files, and history.

methods.name: deleteDocumentStoreFileChunk
methods.description: Deletes a specific file chunk from a document store.

methods.name: deleteVectorStoreFromStore
methods.description: Deletes vector store data associated with a document store.

methods.name: editDocumentStoreFileChunk
methods.description: Edits the content and metadata of a specific file chunk.

methods.name: updateDocumentStore
methods.description: Updates a document store with new data.

methods.name: _saveFileToStorage
methods.description: Saves a base64-encoded file to storage and updates usage.

methods.name: _splitIntoChunks
methods.description: Splits data into chunks using specified splitter and loader components.

methods.name: _normalizeFilePaths
methods.description: Normalizes file paths in loader configs, converting storage references to base64 strings.

methods.name: previewChunksMiddleware
methods.description: Middleware to handle previewing chunks, optionally queuing jobs.

methods.name: previewChunks
methods.description: Generates preview chunks from loader data, with optional limiting.

methods.name: saveProcessingLoader
methods.description: Saves or updates a processing loader configuration in a document store.

methods.name: processLoader
methods.description: Processes a loader for a document store, including chunk storage.
